city_scope_filter.boundary_licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; contains Ordnance Survey and ONS intellectual property rights.
city_scope_filter.boundary_scope: Greater London region E12000007, December 2024, generalised 20m and clipped to coastline.
city_scope_filter.method: Retains current OSM major-road features only where they intersect the official city boundary polygon, then splits or truncates line geometry at the boundary using source vertices and approximate crossing points. The boundary scopes the visual context; OSM remains the road-geometry source.

metadata.method: Road features inside the official city boundary are colored from nearby source-backed transport records in a rolling three-year window.
metadata.caveat: Transport road colors are activity hotspots, not measured traffic counts or live congestion.
